title: 7 Best Rork Alternatives in 2026: Honest Comparison
summary: Rork alternatives ranked by backend depth, cross-platform reach, and pricing. Blink, FlutterFlow, Adalo, Glide, Thunkable, Replit, Emergent — honest pros and cons.
body_markdown: Blink and Emergent both generate a real backend, database, and auth alongside the mobile app in the same build. Adalo includes a native database but no code export. FlutterFlow, Glide, Thunkable, and Replit all connect to an external backend (Firebase, Sheets, or a database you configure) rather than shipping one natively bundled the way Blink does.
